analysis: CORRECTION 9/30: the prior write-up said Patrick Mahomes has been out all season -- wrong. He has started all three games (KC 3-0; 20/24, 246 yds, 2 TD vs MIA in Wk3). The model total of 44.1 also leans heavily on prior-season placeholder games: 5 of the 8 games in each team's rolling scoring window are regressed 2025 rates (KC 21.6 scored, LV 18.1). Using only the three real 2026 games (KC 29.3 scored / 16.7 allowed, LV 29.3 / 18.0), the same formula projects about 46.7 -- under a point below the 47.5 market, not 3.4.

The one real pro-under signal is market behavior: the total opened 48.5 and slipped to 47.5 while 71% of tickets and 83% of handle sit on the over -- a small move against the public money. Against that, both teams' 2026 games have gone 41, 63, 34 (KC) and 40, 40, 62 (LV), the game is indoors, and KC is missing LT Josh Simmons. Net: a thin, mostly market-driven under lean, not a model edge.

leans.reasoning: Model gap shrinks from 3.4 to ~0.8 on real 2026 data only; the only independent support is a 1-pt drop against 83% over handle.
